case_inputs.available: Three suitable mobile robots are available for this mission. Inspect storage zone alpha and storage zone beta. Decide how to divide the work.
case_inputs.minimum: At least two mobile robots must participate in this mission. Inspect storage zone alpha and storage zone beta. Decide how to divide the work while preserving that participation requirement.
case_inputs.universal: All three available mobile robots must participate in this mission. Inspect storage zone alpha and storage zone beta. Decide how to divide the work while preserving that participation requirement.

interpretation_note: This bounded study checks the production Interpreter on three generic participation semantics. It does not prove Planner, Reviewer, Control, or physical execution behavior.
